title: Kuma Miko's Masume Yoshimoto Launches New Manga
content:
The 37th issue of Champion Buzz , the digital magazine supplement to Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine, revealed on Thursday that Masume Yoshimoto will launch a new manga (pictured left below) titled Kyō wa Kawabe de Sugoshitai (I Want to Spend the Day at the Riverbank) in the supplement's next issue on November 5.

The manga centers on Sawakita, who spends his lunchbreaks at the riverbank, away from work and noise. One day something appears before him.

Yoshimoto launched the Kuma Miko: Girl Meets Bear manga in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Flapper magazine in 2013, and ended it in December 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's 20th and final compiled book volume in January 2024. One Peace Books is releasing the manga in North America, and released the eighth volume in 2018.

A television anime adaptation of the manga premiered in 2016. Funimation streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

title: New Saga's Jun Miura Launches New Manga on October 8
content:
The official X/Twitter account for Overlap 's Comic Gardo manga website announced on Thursday that Jun Miura will launch a new manga titled Moto Shinryū, Chippoke na Ningen ni Tensei Shita Kedo Musō Shimasu (The Divine Dragon Remains Overpowered Despite Reincarnating as a Small Human) on the website on October 8.

The manga centers on a boy who awakens to the powers of a dragon, who uses his strength to protect his family.

Miura launched a manga adaptation of Masayuki Abe 's Tsuyokute New Saga (New Saga Plus, a wordplay on the Japanese term for replay mode) light novel series in AlphaPolis in February 2014. The manga ended in July 2023. AlphaPolis published the manga's 11th and final compiled book volume in June 2025. AlphaPolis ' Alpha Manga service is publishing the manga in English under the title New Saga .

The original novels inspired a television anime that debuted in July 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in Japan.

title: Light Novel 'Tokyo Ravens' Ends with 18th Volumes
content:
The official X for the Tokyo Ravens light novel series announced on Friday that the series will end with its 18th volume, scheduled for release this Winter.

Kouhei Azano ( Black Blood Brothers ) originally began the school supernatural series under Fujimi Fantasia Bunko imprint in May 2010, featuring illustrations by Sumihei . Kadokawa published the 17th volume in March 2025. The series has a cumulative 1 million copies of its volumes in circulation in September 2023.

A side-story light novel series titled Tokyo Ravens EX ran from July 2013 to August 2016 and consists of four volumes.

Tokyo Ravens went on a prolonged hiatus of more than six years following the release of the 16th volume in October 2018.

Atsushi Suzumi launched a manga adaptation in Shounen Ace magazine from April 2010 to July 2017. Kadokawa published the 15th and final volume in September 2017.

Several other manga adaptations have also been released, including Tokyo Ravens: Tokyo Fox , Tokyo Ravens: Sword of Song , Tokyo Ravens: Red and White , Tokyo Ravens: ANOTHER×holiday , and Tokyo Ravens: Girls Photograph .

Kadokawa published the first 11 volumes of the main manga digitally in English via BookWalker between October 2014 and June 2015. Yen Press later acquired the digital license.

The series also ranked 7th in the tankobon division of Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! guidebook in 2014. It also placed 10th in the light novel category of the 2014 Denshi Shoseki Award.

8bit produced a 24-episode television anime adaptation that aired from October 2013 to March 2014. Funimation (now Crunchyroll) streamed the series with multiple languages and an English dub. The company also released the series on home video in North America.

title: Devils' Crest TV Anime Reveals More Cast, Ending Theme in 2nd Promo Video
content:
The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, revealed the show's second promotional video on Friday. The video reveals and previews Soala 's ending theme song "ReaL."

The website also revealed two more cast members.

Atsushi Tamaru as Shin Haizaki

Ayumu Murase as Kakeru Niki

The anime will premiere worldwide on November 6 on Amazon Prime Video .

The anime will star:

• Haruka Shiraishi as Yuma Ashihara

• Konomi Inagaki as Sawa Ashihara

• Yūya Hirose as Kenji Kondō

• Satomi Amano as Minagi Sano

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo

• Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono

• Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki

• Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki

Shinji Ushiro ( Yōkai Watch , Mazica Party , Scum of the Brave ) is the anime's chief director at Production I.G , and Kenichirō Komaya ( Nina the Starry Bride , Kizuna no Allele ) is directing the anime. Eiji Umehara ( Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- scripts, series composition for Suicide Squad ISEKAI ) is overseeing the series scripts, and the original novels' illustrator Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters. Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ) and Naoyuki Chikatani ( Ya Boy Kongming! live-action series and film, I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons anime) are composing the music.

Ado performs the opening theme song "Shinka" (Evolution).

Yen Press licensed the novels, and it describes the story:

The latest VRMMORPG, Actual Magic, has sealed an entire class of sixth graders in a terrifying game of life or death. Countless dangers await eleven-year-old Yuuma and his friends. One of their classmates has been turned into a monster, and gargantuan beasts lurk around every corner. Their only hope? The demon Valac who has possessed Yuuma's twin sister. Following Valac's guidance, Yuuma and his party set out to save their missing friend, Nagi. But an unexpected encounter awaits them...

Kawahara launched the series with the first novel volume in November 2022. Kadokawa released the fourth novel volume in December 2025. Yen Press released the third novel volume in English in December 2025. Tomoe (art) and Koroku Takano (script) launched a vertical-scrolling manga adaptation of the novels in Wit Studio 's vertical-scrolling manga service HykeComic in November 2022. Kadokawa released the manga's first compiled book volume in June 2024, and will release both the second and third volumes on October 23.

Kawahara is best known for his Sword Art Online novels.The series has inspired novel and manga spinoffs, a television anime adaptation with several seasons, an anime film, and proposed live-action series . Kawahara's Sword Art Online: Progressive spinoff novel series inspired two anime films of its own.

Kawahara also penned the Accel World novel series, which inspired its own manga adaptations, a television anime adaptation, and an anime film. He also penned The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude light novel series. Yen Press is releasing the Sword Art Online , Accel World , and The Isolator: Realization of Absolute Solitude novels in English.

title: 'Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken' Announces Supporting Cast
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) announced the supporting cast for its seventh part, Steel Ball Run , on Friday. The second and third stages of the anime, which adapt the seventh part of Hirohiko Araki 's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga, began streaming exclusively worldwide on Netflix on September 25, with new episodes released weekly.

Cast L. A. Boom Boom: Fumiyoshi Shioya ( Shangri-La Frontier: Kusoge Hunter, Kamige ni Idoman to su ) Andre Boom Boom: Yoshiki Nakajima ( Kill Ao ) Benjamin Boom Boom: Jirou Saitou ( Hokuto no Ken: Fist of the North Star )

Yasuhiro Kimura ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 5: Ougon no Kaze ) and Hideya Takahashi ( Keijo!!!!!!!! ) are directing the anime at David Production , with Toshiyuki Katou ( JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken Part 6: Stone Ocean ) serving as series director.

Yasuko Kobayashi ( Dororo ) is handling the series composition, with Daisuke Tsumagari ( Kishibe Rohan wa Ugokanai chief animation director) designing the characters and serving as the chief animation director. Yugo Kanno ( Pluto ) is composing the music.

Hirohiko Araki originally launched Steel Ball Run in Weekly Shounen Jump in January 2004 as an unrelated story to the series. Following its transfer to Ultra Jump in April 2005, it became an official part, set in an alternate timeline. Shueisha published the manga in 24 volumes between May 2004 and June 2011, later compiling it into 16 volumes from February 2017 to January 2018.

Araki launched the action adventure manga series with the first part, Phantom Blood , in Weekly Shounen Jump in 1986. The second through six part— Sentou Chouryuu ( Battle Tendency ), Stardust Crusaders , Diamond wa Kudakenai ( Diamond Is Unbreakable ), Ougon no Kaze ( Golden Wind ), and Stone Ocean —ran in the same magazine between 1987 and 2003.

The eighth part, JoJolion , ended in August 2021 in Ultra Jump after a ten-year run. Shueisha published the 27th and final volume in September that year.

The JoJoLands , the ninth part of the manga series, debuted in Ultra Jump in February 2023. Shueisha released the ninth and latest volume on September 17.

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Releases Creditless Opening Ahead of Today's Premiere
content:
The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has released its creditless opening sequence featuring Yorushika’s new song “Beyond the Clouds, Only Me Downwind” ( Kumo wo Nuke Kazashimo e Watashi Dake ). The anime will lead up to the upcoming movie , which will premiere in Japan on December 11 with an original story by the author Natsu Hyuuga. The second cour of Season 3 is scheduled for April 2027.

Studio OLM is back to handle the animation production, while TOHO animation STUDIO is notably absent from the staff credits list. The new song was written, composed and arranged by n-buna. The opening animation was storyboarded and directed by Ayaka Nakata, with Yukiko Nakatani serving as chief animation director and Kaori Saito of Wish credited as animation director.

You can watch the new opening below.

ALSO READ: The Apothecary Diaries Interview: Aoi Yuki (Maomao) & Takeo Otsuka (Jinshi) Crunchyroll Reveals New York Comic Con 2026 Lineup With The Apothecary Diaries, Sentenced to Be a Hero, Black Clover and More

The main staff was also previously revealed and includes:

• Director: Akinori Fudesaka

• Assistant Director: Wataru Nakagawa

• Series Composition: Norihiro Naganuma

• Scripts: Yuko Kakihara, Misuzu Chiba, Hitomi Ogawa

• Character Design: Yukiko Nakatani

• Art Director: Katsumi Takao

• Color Design: Misato Aida, Nanako Okazaki

• CGI Director: Tamotsu Nagai

• Director of Photography: Mayo Suzuki

• Editing: Daisuke Imai

• Sound Director: Shoji Hata

• Music: Satoru Kosaki, Kevin Penkin, Arisa Okehazama

• Animation Production: OLM

You can also see the key visual:

Natsu Hyuga writes the The Apothecary Diaries light novel, with illustrations by Toko Shino. The series is serialized by Shunfunotomo. The series has 2 manga adaptations, one written by Itsuki Nanao and illustrated by Nekokurage, and one written and illustrated by Minoji Kurata.

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel in English, while Squre Enix is publishing the manga. The story follows Maomao, a young apothecary who ends up getting sold to the emperor’s palace as a lowly servant. She’s not the type of character who can just stay obedient, so she ends up helping Jinshi, the handsome official at the palace.

The franchise recently also announced its first live-action series adaptation , as well as the first console game . The Failure at God School , a manga with story written by Natsu Hyuga, also recently announced an anime adaptation .

title: 'Demons' Crest' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the original net anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest light novel unveiled a pair of additional cast, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.

Voice actors Atsushi Tamaru ( Nigashita Sakana wa Ookikatta ga Tsuriageta Sakana ga Ookisugita Ken ) and Ayumu Murase ( Yomi no Tsugai ) are joining the cast as Shin Haizaki and Kakeru Niki, respectively.

Singer-songwriter Soala ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) is performing the ending theme "ReaL," which previewed in the second promotional video below.

Kenichirou Komaya ( Hoshifuru Oukoku no Nina ) is directing the anime at Production I.G , with Eiji Umehara ( Vivy: Fluorite Eye's Song ) handling the series composition. Yukiko Horiguchi ( 22/7 ) is designing the characters. Yuuki Hayashi ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) and Naoyuki Chikatani ( Yuusha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Beast Tamer, Saikyoushu no Nekomimi Shoujo to Deau ) are composing the music.

Kawahara ( Sword Art Online ) began publishing the light novel with illustrations by Yukiko Horiguchi ( Kokoro Connect ) under Kadokawa's Dengeki Bunko imprint in November 2022. The fourth volume was released on December 10 last year.

A webtoon adaptation drawn by TOmoe began serialization on Akatsuki's HykeComic platform in November 2022. Kadokawa published the first volume in June 2024, with the second and third volume scheduled for an October 23 release.

Yen Press licensed the light novel in English in January 2024 and shipped the third volume in December 2025.

title: WEBTOON Entertainment Names 2 Co-CEOs for Naver Webtoon
content:
WEBTOON Entertainment's Korean subsidiary Naver Webtoon appointed WEBTOON Entertainment President Yongsoo Kim and Chief Administrative Officer Gyu-nam Kim as co-CEOs on October 1.

Yongsoo Kim will retain his role as President of WEBTOON Entertainment while overseeing Naver Webtoon's operations, while Gyu-nam Kim will serve as both CAO of WEBTOON Entertainment and co-CEO of Naver Webtoon.

The changes are part of a broader leadership restructuring that began at WEBTOON Entertainment in March. The founder of WEBTOON Entertainment, Junkoo Kim , will step down as Naver Webtoon's CEO and focus on his role as chairman and CEO of WEBTOON Entertainment, with an emphasis on the company's long-term growth and global operations.

Gyu-nam Kim joined Naver Webtoon in 2018 and has led content policy, creator systems, content operations, and anti-piracy initiatives. In his new role, he will focus on working with Korean creators, partners, government agencies, and industry organizations.

Yongsoo Kim joined WEBTOON Entertainment in 2022 and previously served as CSO and head of its global webtoon business. He also helped oversee the company's IPO and has led partnerships with global entertainment companies. As President since March, he has focused on company-wide operations and efficiency.

WEBTOON Entertainment said the new structure is intended to strengthen local management in Korea while improving coordination between its global operations and regional subsidiaries.

title: Voice Actor Naoki Bandō Dies at 69
content:
Voice actor Naoki Bandō died on Monday, September 28. He was 69.

Bandō's management agency Production Ace announced his death on Friday, adding that he had been undergoing medical treatment.

Bandō voiced Robonyan and a large number of other characters in the Yo-kai Watch franchise . He provided the voice for Torenov Y. Minovsky, a pivotal character in the UC universe of the Gundam franchise in Mobile Suit Gundam: The Origin .

His other notable roles include Silvarion in The Brave of Gold Goldran , Guard Star in The Brave Fighter of Sun Fighbird , Kintetsu Oosawagi in Urayasu Tekkin Kazoku , Vargas Dyson in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE , Gato in Naruto , Centichoro in One-Punch Man , Emon in Shadow of the Colossus , and Larikush in Baten Kaitos , among numerous other smaller roles over more than four decades in voice acting.

He also voiced Japanese dub roles in foreign films, television shows, and animated works, such as ER , 24 , Casino Royale , and The Matrix .

His other notable roles include Silvarion in The Brave of Gold Goldran , Guard Star in The Brave Fighter of Sun Fighbird , Kintetsu Oosawagi in Urayasu Tekkin Kazoku , Vargas Dyson in Mobile Suit Gundam AGE , Gato in Naruto , Centichoro in One-Punch Man , Emon in Shadow of the Colossus , and Larikush in Baten Kaitos , among numerous other smaller roles over more than four decades in voice acting.
He also voiced Japanese dub roles in foreign films, television shows, and animated works, such as ER , 24 , Casino Royale , and The Matrix .

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Yūichi Nakamura
content:
CyberAgent revealed on Friday that Yūichi Nakamura is joining the cast of the television anime of Takeru Hokazono 's Kagurabachi manga as Soshiro Azami, a sorcerer affiliated with the Kamunabi.

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service are releasing the Kagurabachi manga digitally in English. MANGA Plus describes the story:

Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge. Epic sword battle action!

The anime stars:

• Taihi Kimura as Chihiro Rokuhira

• Tomokazu Seki as Kunishige Rokuhira

• Katsuyuki Konishi as Togo Shiba

• Miku Itō as Hinao

• Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi

Tetsuya Takeuchi ( From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated! director; key animator for Naruto and Naruto Shippūden ) is directing the anime at Cypic ( The World Is Dancing ). Keigo Sasaki (character designer for Blue Exorcist , Uma Musume: Cinderella Gray ) is designing the characters. Shochiku and CyberAgent are on the production committee .

The anime will premiere in April 2027, and will stream that month worldwide excluding Japan, Mainland China, North Korea, and South Korea. The "world tour" event for the anime began this past July at Anime Expo in Los Angeles, Japan Expo Paris in Paris, ANImagic in Mannheim, Germany, and in August at Anime NYC in New York. The event is showing the first 20 minutes of the first episode, and will end in Japan in spring 2027 where the full first episode will be screened.

Hokazono debuted the Kagurabachi manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in September 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 12th compiled volume in Japan on September 4. The manga surpassed 2.2 million copies in circulation as of May 2025. The manga has 4 million copies in circulation.

Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print and released the eighth volume on August 4.

The manga topped the print category in the Next Manga Awards 2024. The manga was nominated in December 2024 for the 70th Shogakukan Manga Awards, and was nominated for the 49th annual Kodansha Manga Awards in April 2025. The manga was also nominated for the 2025 Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards. The manga ranked at #13 in January for Da Vinci's top manga titles of 2025.

CyberAgent established Cygames in 2011, and the company has produced games such as Rage of Bahamut and Granblue Fantasy . Cygames established an anime division in March 2015 and the anime production subsidiary Cygames Pictures in April 2016.
